scoreReasons: Everything the registries record is public by design: token ownership, agentURI, metadata including agentWallet, every feedback value and tag, revocations and responses.
Named events (Registered, URIUpdated, MetadataSet, NewFeedback, FeedbackRevoked, ResponseAppended) at the same proxy addresses on every listed mainnet make indexing simple.
Registration files, feedback files and the /.well-known domain proof are public whenever their URI is public.
Public explorers, subgraphs and a CC BY 4.0 census dataset already exist.
What stays private is only what parties choose not to publish, such as the payment details behind a feedback entry; the quality of the data is the weak point, not its visibility.
